newsitem.title: USA: MCI largest holder in Pan Am Cable System.
newsitem.headline: MCI largest holder in Pan Am Cable System.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said Wednesday that it is the largest U.S. shareholder of the new Pan American Cable System connecting the United States with Central and South America.

The cable will be about 4,354 miles long, and cost about $214 million, MCI said. It will allow MCI to provide broadband switched services and broadband access to such services as the Internet, MCI said.
MCI said the cable would begin service in mid-1998.
Other investors in the cable are Telefonica del Peru SA, Telecom Italia, Emetel Ecuador, CANTV of Venezuela, Telecom Colombia and MCII de Venezuela.
